Levy Harkins & Company Inc decreased its stake in Nvidia Inc. (NVDA) by 4.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 60,115 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.63M, down from 63,195 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Levy Harkins & Company Inc who had been investing in Nvidia Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $148.19 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.40% or $11.24 during the last trading session, reaching $244.12. About 19.18 million shares traded or 28.35% up from the average. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has risen 108.33% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 96.78% the S&P500.
